Tolerance Rates for Transition Heterogeneity

Source: R/manMetaVAR-data-tolerance-rates.R
tolerance_rates.Rd

Proportions of replications in which the estimate or interval of a between-person variance or covariance of the transition parameters falls within or beyond a tolerance \(\delta\), computed with SumTolerance() from the replication-level simulation summaries.

Usage

data(tolerance_rates)

Format

A data frame with one row per design condition, method, interval type, parameter, and tolerance:

taskid

Simulation task ID.

replications

Number of replications.

replications_used

Number of admissible replications.

method

Estimation method, labeled as in results.

ci

Confidence or credible interval method.

n

Number of persons.

time

Number of measurement occasions; NA denotes the unbalanced condition.

heterogeneity

Transition-parameter heterogeneity multiplier: 0, 1, or 2.

parnames

Parameter name.

parameter

Population value.

type

"variance" or "covariance".

delta

Tolerance.

est_within

Proportion of estimates within the tolerance.

equivalent

Proportion of intervals within the tolerance (practical homogeneity).

exceed

Proportion of intervals beyond the tolerance (heterogeneity beyond the tolerance).
